text:
sasha: Heads up — seeing a 3x jump in correctable ECCs across apac-gpu-pool-3 since ~09:12 UTC. Grafana panel (gpu-ecc): query `sum(rate(gpu_ecc_correctable_total[5m])) by (card, pool)` shows several cards pegged. XIDs mostly 45 and 61. Any preference: soft-quarantine vs immediate drain? cc @jamie @maria

jamie: can we confirm spike duration first? if it's a blip we avoid churn. what's baseline for that pool (median over last 7d)? :thinking:

maria: APAC is short on spare capacity today (reserved jobs are heavy). If we drain we risk higher p99 latency for prod tenants. prefer quarantine gating rules rather than full drain. :worried:

alex: proposal: new metric ecc_rate_per_hour_per_card and adaptive hysteresis: trigger when card > 2x rolling-median for 30m AND card contributes >10% of pool error volume. release when <1.2x for 60m. prevents flip-flop.

oncall-bot: ALERT: gpu-ecc-correctable-rate-high (apac-gpu-pool-3) fired at 2025-05-15T09:15:37Z — firing cards: node-gpu-27,node-gpu-31,node-gpu-34.

kevin: +1 to hysteresis. Also suggest quick health probe before quarantine: run `kubectl debug node/node-gpu-27 -- image=redwood/gpu-tools -- curl http://localhost:9100/metrics | grep ecc` or run `cuda-memtest --duration 10m` job on node. If memtest fails -> schedule replacement.

sasha: good. I'm +1 on making the alert require sustained 30m window and adding a tag `suspect_flaky_card=true` to telemetry so ops can filter noisy cards. I'll open a PR for alert change and auto-quarantine rule (opt-in).

jamie: ops decision for today: do NOT auto-drain. Manually soft-quarantine the two worst cards (node-gpu-27, node-gpu-31) and run memtest. If memtest fails, drain + reprovision. Maria please confirm capacity fallback plan. :eyes:

maria: ack. I'll re-balance low-priority batch jobs off APAC pool and stand up two spare nodes from warm pool to cover potential drains. ETA 25m.

sasha: created runbook snippet in thread: `if correctable_rate(card) > 2x_median for 30m -> annotate node: kubectl annotate node <node> redwood/quarantine=soft ; kick memtest job ; wait 10m ; if memtest fail -> drain node`

alex: for automation PR, include these constraints: min_pool_free_spares >= 2, require ensemble confirmation (>=2 cards in pool over threshold) and exclude cards with recent firmware upgrades (last 48h).

kevin: note for engineering: XID 61 trace often correlates with PCIe resets — check kernel logs `journalctl -u gpu-manager -o short-iso | grep Xid` and route to hw team if repeats.

maria: standing up spares now. will update ETA in 10m. :thumbsup:

sasha: thanks everyone — I'll draft the PR and the short-term manual checklist, will ping this thread when ready. :white_check_mark:
